verdict.rationale: Pricing page explicitly claims 'CRM field sync, updating records after meetings automatically' and 'Deal View summarizing insights', indicating CRM sync of notes/summaries to contact/deal records. However, there is no documentation of which CRMs are supported (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio specifically), no setup/integration guide, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of how matching to contacts/deals works. missing for 10: named CRM integrations (HubSpot/Salesforce/Attio) with setup docs, technical details on contact/deal matching logic, independent verification of accuracy/reliability of the sync.
